Diamond prices rose in August: Rapaport's one-carat index gained 0.5%, its first increase in fifteen months. The 0.50-carat added 2.5% and the 0.30-carat 2.0%, while the three-carat, steady for eighteen months, slipped 0.4%. Rapaport credits supply discipline, not returning demand. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

India has put a syllabus behind its lab-grown diamond programme. IIGJ and IIT Madras's InCent-LGD centre launched a 90-hour certificate on 2 September: 60 hours of growth physics from IIT Madras, 30 hours of markets and trade from IIGJ, and only 12 hours on campus. No fee, cohort size or start date has been published. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
